def classify_failure_taxonomy(
    *,
    status: str = "",
    blockers: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] = (),
    error_code: str = "",
    causal_evidence: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Classify a Worker/MCP failure into the canonical taxonomy without blind string-only mutation."""
    tokens = " | ".join(
        [
            str(status or "").strip().upper(),
            str(error_code or "").strip().upper(),
            *(str(b or "").strip().upper() for b in (blockers or ())),
        ]
    )
    has_causal_evidence = isinstance(causal_evidence, dict) and bool(causal_evidence)

    for (
        failure_class,
        domain_category,
        patterns,
        recoverable_auto,
        approval_required,
        strategy,
        max_attempts,
    ) in FAILURE_TAXONOMY_RULES:
        if any(pat in tokens for pat in patterns):
            auto_repair_allowed = bool(
                recoverable_auto
                and not approval_required
                and domain_category not in {"SECURITY", "BUSINESS"}
                and has_causal_evidence
            )
            return {
                "failure_class": failure_class,
                "category": domain_category,
                "recoverable_automatically": recoverable_auto,
                "human_approval_required": approval_required,
                "requires_causal_evidence": True,
                "has_causal_evidence": has_causal_evidence,
                "auto_repair_allowed": auto_repair_allowed,
                "recovery_strategy": strategy,
                "max_attempts": max_attempts,
                "production_touched": False,
            }

    return {
        "failure_class": "UNCLASSIFIED_NON_RECOVERABLE",
        "category": "NON_RECOVERABLE",
        "recoverable_automatically": False,
        "human_approval_required": True,
        "requires_causal_evidence": True,
        "has_causal_evidence": has_causal_evidence,
        "auto_repair_allowed": False,
        "recovery_strategy": "FAIL_CLOSED_HUMAN_REQUIRED",
        "max_attempts": 0,
        "production_touched": False,
    }


def _circuit_path(signature_key: str, *, state_dir: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    clean = str(signature_key or "").strip()
    if not _SAFE_CIRCUIT_KEY_RE.fullmatch(clean):
        raise ValueError("CIRCUIT_KEY_INVALID")
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", clean)
    root = state_dir or CIRCUIT_BREAKER_DIR
    return root / f"{safe_name}.json"


def _atomic_write_json(path: Path, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    import tempfile

    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
        "w", encoding="utf-8", dir=path.parent, delete=False
    ) as handle:
        json.dump(payload, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        handle.write("
")
        temp_name = handle.name
    os.replace(temp_name, path)


def evaluate_circuit_breaker(
    signature_key: str,
    *,
    max_failures: int = 3,
    cooldown_seconds: int = 900,
    now_epoch: float | None = None,
    state_dir: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Fail-closed persistent circuit breaker preventing infinite repair retries."""
    import time

    now_ts = float(now_epoch if now_epoch is not None else time.time())
    path = _circuit_path(signature_key, state_dir=state_dir)
    data = _load_json(path) or {}
    failures = int(data.get("consecutive_failures") or 0)
    last_failure_epoch = float(data.get("last_failure_epoch") or 0.0)

    if failures >= max_failures:
        elapsed = now_ts - last_failure_epoch
        if elapsed < cooldown_seconds:
            return {
                "signature_key": signature_key,
                "state": "OPEN",
                "allow_attempt": False,
                "consecutive_failures": failures,
                "cooldown_remaining_seconds": max(0, int(cooldown_seconds - elapsed)),
                "reason": "CIRCUIT_OPEN_MAX_FAILURES",
                "production_touched": False,
            }
        return {
            "signature_key": signature_key,
            "state": "HALF_OPEN",
            "allow_attempt": True,
            "consecutive_failures": failures,
            "cooldown_remaining_seconds": 0,
            "reason": "CIRCUIT_HALF_OPEN_PROBE",
            "production_touched": False,
        }

    return {
        "signature_key": signature_key,
        "state": "CLOSED",
        "allow_attempt": True,
        "consecutive_failures": failures,
        "cooldown_remaining_seconds": 0,
        "reason": "CIRCUIT_CLOSED",
        "production_touched": False,
    }


def record_circuit_outcome(
    signature_key: str,
    *,
    certified_success: bool,
    failure_class: str = "",
    now_epoch: float | None = None,
    state_dir: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Record failure or certified recovery without storing any secrets."""
    import time

    now_ts = float(now_epoch if now_epoch is not None else time.time())
    path = _circuit_path(signature_key, state_dir=state_dir)
    prior = _load_json(path) or {}

    if certified_success:
        record = {
            "schema": "edarsahub.worker-circuit-breaker.v1",
            "signature_key": signature_key,
            "consecutive_failures": 0,
            "last_failure_epoch": 0.0,
            "last_certified_epoch": now_ts,
            "last_failure_class": "",
            "production_touched": False,
        }
    else:
        record = {
            "schema": "edarsahub.worker-circuit-breaker.v1",
            "signature_key": signature_key,
            "consecutive_failures": int(prior.get("consecutive_failures") or 0) + 1,
            "last_failure_epoch": now_ts,
            "last_certified_epoch": float(prior.get("last_certified_epoch") or 0.0),
            "last_failure_class": str(failure_class or "UNKNOWN")[:120],
            "production_touched": False,
        }
    _atomic_write_json(path, record)
    return record


def assess_knowledge_loop_cycle(
    *,
    incident_id: str,
    status: str = "",
    blockers: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] = (),
    error_code: str = "",
    causal_evidence: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    max_failures: int = 3,
    cooldown_seconds: int = 900,
    now_epoch: float | None = None,
    state_dir: Path | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Evaluate Detect -> Classify -> Diagnose -> Circuit Breaker -> Authorize for one incident."""
    classification = classify_failure_taxonomy(
        status=status,
        blockers=blockers,
        error_code=error_code,
        causal_evidence=causal_evidence,
    )
    circuit = evaluate_circuit_breaker(
        incident_id,
        max_failures=max_failures,
        cooldown_seconds=cooldown_seconds,
        now_epoch=now_epoch,
        state_dir=state_dir,
    )

    if not circuit["allow_attempt"]:
        next_step = "CIRCUIT_OPEN_STOP"
    elif classification["human_approval_required"] or classification["category"] in {"SECURITY", "BUSINESS"}:
        next_step = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
    elif not classification["has_causal_evidence"]:
        next_step = "COLLECT_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE_FIRST"
    elif classification["auto_repair_allowed"]:
        next_step = "AUTO_REPAIR_ELIGIBLE"
    else:
        next_step = classification["recovery_strategy"]

    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-knowledge-loop-assessment.v1",
        "incident_id": incident_id,
        "classification": classification,
        "circuit_breaker": circuit,
        "next_step": next_step,
        "learning_allowed_only_if_certified": True,
        "production_touched": False,
    }

"""Gate D tests: Failure taxonomy (22+ classes), persistent circuit breaker, and Knowledge Loop."""
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from tools.mirror_sync import worker_repair_auto_loop as loop


def test_taxonomy_covers_all_required_failure_classes_and_never_auto_repairs_security():
    cases = [
        ("INVALID_JOB_TEMPLATE_SCHEMA", "INVALID_CONTRACT", "CONTRACT", False),
        ("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN", "UNKNOWN_MCP_CAPABILITY", "CONTRACT", False),
        ("RBAC_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN", "INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS", "SECURITY", False),
        ("START_JOB_ALREADY_EXISTS", "DUPLICATE_JOB", "CONTRACT", False),
        ("PUBLISHED_RESULT_COMMIT_BLOB_MISSING", "CONTRADICTORY_NOT_FOUND", "INFRASTRUCTURE", True),
        ("SEMANTIC_SOURCE_SHA256_MISMATCH", "STALE_SOURCE_SHA256", "CONTRACT", True),
        ("GIT_DIVERGENCE_BLOCKED", "GIT_MIRROR_DIVERGENCE", "INFRASTRUCTURE", True),
        ("GIT_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN", "DIRTY_WORKTREE", "INFRASTRUCTURE", False),
        ("CONCURRENT_SCOPE_CONFLICT", "CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT", "TRANSIENT", True),
        ("MODULENOTFOUNDERROR", "MISSING_DEPENDENCY", "INFRASTRUCTURE", False),
        ("GIT_TESTS_FAILED", "TEST_FAILURE", "CONTRACT", False),
        ("GIT_PUSH_FAILED", "INCOMPLETE_PUBLICATION", "TRANSIENT", True),
        ("EVIDENCE_TRUNCATED", "ABSENT_OR_TRUNCATED_EVIDENCE", "CONTRACT", False),
        ("CONTRADICTORY_RESULT_ARTIFACT", "CONTRADICTORY_RESULT", "INFRASTRUCTURE", False),
        ("PENDING_AUDIT_EVIDENCE", "PENDING_ATTESTATION", "TRANSIENT", True),
        ("RUNTIME_RESTART_TRANSIENT", "RUNTIME_RESTART_OR_TRANSIENT", "TRANSIENT", True),
        ("SLOT_EXPIRED", "STUCK_OR_EXPIRED_JOB", "TRANSIENT", True),
        ("CONNECTIONREFUSED", "CONNECTION_LOSS", "INTEGRATION", True),
        ("ENOSPC", "STORAGE_OR_RESOURCE_LIMIT", "INFRASTRUCTURE", False),
        ("NAIVE_DATETIME", "DATE_OR_TIMEZONE_ERROR", "BUSINESS", False),
        ("SCOPE_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED", "EMPRESA_OR_SUCURSAL_AUTH_FAILURE", "SECURITY", False),
        ("REJECTED_UNSAFE_OR_OVERSIZED", "SENSITIVE_DATA_EXPOSURE_RISK", "SECURITY", False),
        ("PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN", "PRODUCTION_POLICY_VIOLATION", "SECURITY", False),
    ]
    for code, expected_cls, expected_cat, expected_auto in cases:
        res = loop.classify_failure_taxonomy(
            error_code=code,
            causal_evidence={"source_job_id": "JOB-1", "verified": True},
        )
        assert res["failure_class"] == expected_cls, f"{code} -> {res}"
        assert res["category"] == expected_cat
        assert res["auto_repair_allowed"] is expected_auto
        assert res["production_touched"] is False

    # Superficial string match WITHOUT causal evidence MUST NOT authorize auto repair
    no_ev = loop.classify_failure_taxonomy(
        error_code="GIT_DIVERGENCE_BLOCKED",
        causal_evidence=None,
    )
    assert no_ev["auto_repair_allowed"] is False


def test_persistent_circuit_breaker_opens_after_threshold_and_resets_only_on_certified(tmp_path):
    cb_dir = tmp_path / "cb"
    key = "INC-TEST-CIRCUIT-001"
    t0 = 1_700_000_000.0

    assert loop.evaluate_circuit_breaker(key, now_epoch=t0, state_dir=cb_dir)["state"] == "CLOSED"

    for idx in range(3):
        loop.record_circuit_outcome(
            key,
            certified_success=False,
            failure_class="GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
            now_epoch=t0 + idx,
            state_dir=cb_dir,
        )

    opened = loop.evaluate_circuit_breaker(key, now_epoch=t0 + 10, state_dir=cb_dir)
    assert opened["state"] == "OPEN"
    assert opened["allow_attempt"] is False
    assert opened["reason"] == "CIRCUIT_OPEN_MAX_FAILURES"

    # Knowledge loop blocks repair while circuit is open
    assessment = loop.assess_knowledge_loop_cycle(
        incident_id=key,
        error_code="GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
        causal_evidence={"source_job_id": "JOB-1"},
        now_epoch=t0 + 10,
        state_dir=cb_dir,
    )
    assert assessment["next_step"] == "CIRCUIT_OPEN_STOP"

    # After cooldown -> HALF_OPEN probe allowed
    half_open = loop.evaluate_circuit_breaker(key, now_epoch=t0 + 950, state_dir=cb_dir)
    assert half_open["state"] == "HALF_OPEN"
    assert half_open["allow_attempt"] is True

    # Certified recovery resets circuit back to CLOSED
    loop.record_circuit_outcome(key, certified_success=True, now_epoch=t0 + 960, state_dir=cb_dir)
    closed = loop.evaluate_circuit_breaker(key, now_epoch=t0 + 965, state_dir=cb_dir)
    assert closed["state"] == "CLOSED"
    assert closed["consecutive_failures"] == 0
